entities.summary: Amy Nnenna Okonkwo is an American-Nigerian professional basketball player for the Dallas Wings of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and Beşiktaş of the Turkish Super League. Born in the United States, she represents Nigeria at international level.
